selection_rule: 89 templates; selected per market and platform seed using mean coalition total utility on 8 attack-validation worlds; 64 new test worlds; no test-based reselection
stage_BR_tie: maximize coalition stage utility; among indifferent actions choose platform-pessimistic expected revenue then lexicographic report, matching the predeclared reference

concrete_profitable_attack.scope: This template was selected on independent attack validation, and its exact trajectory occurred in all 64 fresh test worlds; this is conditional evidence, not universal uncertainty elimination.

limitations: Only three predeclared trained-policy seeds and four fixed markets were attacked.
Finite template search supplies profitable-deviation witnesses and a lower bound, not a complete dynamic equilibrium or robustness proof.
Market D improves coalition utility and platform revenue together under the selected deviations, so coalition gain is not synonymous with platform damage.
Zero-width within-case intervals may arise from deterministic histories; they do not cover broader type/model/training uncertainty.
